metrics.background: mean and SD of tissue pixels below the channel's Otsu threshold (computed on log1p of non-zero tissue pixels)
metrics.stain_index: (mean of positive pixels - mean of background pixels) / (2 x SD of background pixels); flow-cytometry stain index applied to pixels
metrics.positive_fraction: fraction of tissue pixels above the Otsu threshold
metrics.saturation_fraction: fraction of tissue pixels at the bit-depth maximum (255 for 8-bit)
metrics.spill(A->B): (mean B where A is in its top 1%) - (mean B where A is below its median), divided by B's 99.5th percentile. Elevation of B where A is bright, as a share of B's own range
metrics.asymmetry(A->B): spill(A->B) - spill(B->A). Bleed-through and carryover are one-way; biological co-expression is two-way
